message.content:
This is a bicycle accessory, a bottle cage mounting bracket kit that attaches to the saddle. Bicycle parts and accessories fall under heading 8714, and 8714.91 covers frames and forks. 8714.99 covers other parts and accessories, and 8714.96 covers pedals and crank gear. Saddles are 8714.95. A bottle cage is typically classified in 8714.99.8000 ("Other: Other"). The older numbering was 8714.99.80, with statistical suffixes 8714.99.8001 and 8714.99.8000.

I recall CBP rulings for bottle cages classifying them under 8714.99.8050 or 8714.99.8000. The current 8714.99 breakdown is: 8714.99.10 (Brake levers...?), 8714.99.30 (Of bicycles: Other... ), 8714.99.50 (Other: of bicycles), 8714.99.80 (Other). The subheading 8714.99.50 reads "Parts and accessories of bicycles, not motorized: Other: Other: Of bicycles". I believe 8714.99.8000 is the safer choice. Since the kit is for bicycles, 8714.99.5000 might fit better, but the structure I recall is 8714.99.10 (Of motorcycles... ), 8714.99.50 (Of bicycles: Other), 8714.99.80 (Other). I'll go with 8714.99.8000 as the "Other" entry.

Under that structure, a bicycle accessory would more plausibly sit in 8714.99.50 ("Of bicycles"), and that code has a 10-digit form of 8714.99.5000. I'll settle on 8714.99.8000, since I recall that rulings on bottle cages and accessories used it.
